image_description: A close-up shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The main subject is the large, oblong loaf with a dark, reddish-brown glazed crust. A slice has been cut from the left side, revealing the interior texture which appears dense with visible flecks of ingredients. In the background, there are roasted green vegetables (likely Brussels sprouts) and a knife resting on the plate.
